scores.notes: Alice in both is a girl of about eight to ten with long light-brown hair, fair skin and a round face; hair is wavier with a blue band on the left and straighter on the right, but colour, length, age and build agree.

Both show pale limestone flat-roofed houses with dry-stone walls on dry terraced hills with olive trees and cypresses under the same cloudy daylight; left is the yard up close, right the compound seen from the road.
Jesus is a tiny distant figure on the cross on the left with no legible face; on the right he is also small (long dark hair, beard, pale robe), so identity cannot be compared.

Daniel is the lean older man with close-cropped grey hair, short grey beard and olive-brown skin in a dark blue mantle over cream with a satchel, in the left foreground and standing among the lions on the right.
Daniel being lifted from the den on the left and standing right of the steps on the right both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, a lean older face and the same blue mantle with satchel.

Watson seated on the left and standing in a bowler on the right both have brown hair, a full brown moustache, a squarish middle-aged face and medium build; he is small on the right but the cues match.
Holmes with the magnifier on the left and in the armchair on the right has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, hooked nose, high forehead and dark swept-back hair with lean build.

Peter raising the lame man on the left and leaping from the boat on the right both have short dark curly hair going grey, a short dark beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build, with a net over the shoulder.

Watson by the shop on the left and at the door on the right both have a full reddish-brown moustache, fair ruddy skin and a middle-aged face under a bowler; he is small and somewhat stouter on the left, but no clear cue conflicts.
Alice in the courtroom on the left and holding the bottle on the right is the same girl of about nine with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin, a small oval face and slight build.

Watson seated on the left and lying on the bed on the right both have short brown hair, a full brown moustache, fair ruddy skin and a solid build; his arm covers his eyes on the right but hair and moustache are visible.

Peter with hand on chest on the left and the dripping-wet man at the fire on the right both have short dark curly hair with some grey, a short dark beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build in a brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Watson seated on the left has grey-streaked hair, a greying moustache and a lined, heavier face of a man in his fifties; on the right he is a smooth-faced man in his thirties with a dark brown moustache, so apparent age and hair colour conflict.
Holmes in the armchair on the left has a full head of dark swept-back hair; the lean clean-shaven man at the door on the right is bald on top with only side hair, a clear hair conflict.
Alice holding the flamingo on the left and facing the Caterpillar on the right both have long straight light-brown hair, fair skin, the same girlish age and slight build.

Both show a daytime ridged croquet lawn bounded by clipped rounded hedges with tall trees and clusters of giant mushrooms beyond; hoops are striped on the left and plain on the right, a minor difference.
Holmes seated with the pipe on the left and raising the cane on the right has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose, high forehead and dark slicked-back hair with lean build.

Both show a sunlit enclosed ridged lawn with flowering borders, tall trees and mushrooms at the right edge; the left shows a stone garden wall and the right a tall hedge, which fits two sides of one enclosed garden.

Peter gripping the lame man's hand on the left and stepping onto the water on the right both have short dark curly hair with grey flecks, a short dark beard, tanned skin and a sturdy middle-aged build.
Holmes striking with the cane on the left and seated with a pipe on the right has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose, high forehead and dark slicked-back hair with thin build.

Both show a white two-storey country house with a red tiled roof and end chimneys ablaze at night, set back across a lawn at the end of a gravel drive between hedges with fire engines beside it; the left front has gables and more trees, the right a hipped roof with porch and open fields.

Both show a long tea table on grass under a large spreading tree with a pale clapboard house with a porch close behind, in daylight; the table is bare wood on the left and covered by a stained cloth on the right, a prop difference rather than a different place.
Holmes with pipe and magnifier on the left and throwing the paper ball on the right has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose, high forehead and dark swept-back hair with thin build.
Daniel among the lions on the left and in the right foreground both have close-cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, a lean older olive-skinned face and the same dark blue mantle over a pale robe.
Both show dry terraced hills with olive trees and dry-stone walls and pale flat-roofed stone houses in daylight; the left sees the compound from the road, the right stands in its yard.
Holmes holding the magnifier on the left and striking with the cane on the right has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose, high forehead and dark slicked-back hair with thin build.

Moses seated with raised arms on the left and striking the rock on the right is the same old man with white hair, a full white beard, weathered tanned skin and a brown mantle over a pale robe; hair and beard are a little longer on the left.

Daniel in the left foreground and beside the angel on the right both have close-cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, an older olive-brown face and the same blue mantle over a pale robe with a satchel.

Watson on the bed on the left and standing with folded arms on the right both have short brown hair, a full brown moustache, fair ruddy skin and a solid build; he is small on the left with a hand at his brow, but hair and moustache agree.
Holmes with the pipe on the left pavement and in the armchair on the right has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose and dark swept-back hair with thin build, though he is small on the left.

Moses seated between the two men on the left and standing with the staff on the right is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, weathered tanned skin and a brown mantle over a pale robe; hair is fuller and longer on the left but nothing clearly conflicts.
Peter wading ashore on the left and leaping from the boat on the right both have curly grey-streaked dark hair, a short greying beard, tanned skin and a sturdy middle-aged build.
Holmes bent over the hat on the left and holding pipe and magnifier on the right has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose, high forehead and dark swept-back hair.

David dodging the spear on the left and stooping at the brook on the right is the same clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, tanned skin and a slim build in a brown tunic with a shoulder bag.

Moses seated with arms held up on the left and walking with a staff at the right edge on the right is an old man with white hair, a full white beard and a brown mantle over a pale robe; he is smaller on the right but the cues match.

Both show a round sunken pit of large grey stone blocks with lions on a sandy floor and people at the rim above in daylight; the left is seen from outside with city walls, the right from the floor under an arched overhang, which is a viewpoint change.
Moses seated in the middle on the left and raising the rod on the right is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, weathered tanned skin and a brown mantle over a pale robe.

Watson with the bag on the left and seated in the carriage on the right both have short dark-brown hair under a bowler, a full brown moustache, fair skin and a solid build; he looks slightly older on the right but no clear cue conflicts.
Daniel pointing on the left and looking up on the right has the same close-cropped grey hair, short grey beard, lean older olive-brown face and dark blue mantle over a pale robe with a satchel.

Holmes tossing the paper ball on the left and standing with a pipe on the right is the same lean clean-shaven man with a sharp nose and dark swept-back hair; he is small on the right but the cues match.
Moses stretching his staff over the sea on the left (side-on) and striking with the rod on the right is an old man with flowing white hair, a full white beard and a brown mantle over a pale robe.

Both show a dark brick cellar with low round arches and vaults, a worn stone-flag floor and stacked wooden crates lit only by a lantern; the right looks down a longer vaulted passage, compatible with another viewpoint.

Both show the same kind of round open pit lined with large grey stone blocks, with a broad flat rim, sandy floor and dry scrubby ground around, seen from above; the left view takes in a gate, steps and a wall with palms while the right looks out to an empty plain, compatible with opposite viewpoints.
The Cheshire Cat floating above the hedge on the left and lying on the branch on the right is the same grey-brown striped tabby with a broad toothy grin, yellow-green eyes and pointed ears.

Moses pointing at the pig on the left and leading the crowd with a staff on the right is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, tanned skin and a brown mantle over a pale robe; he is smaller on the right but the cues match.

Holmes with the magnifier on the left and tapping the pavement on the right has the same lean clean-shaven face with sharp nose and hollow cheeks and dark hair; he is small and wears a bowler on the right, but no cue conflicts.

Watson lying on the bed on the left and standing in a bowler on the right both have a reddish-brown moustache, ruddy fair skin and a stocky build; his arm hides his eyes on the left and he is small on the right, but the visible cues agree.
Holmes in the armchair on the left and throwing the paper ball on the right has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose, high forehead and dark swept-back hair with thin build.
Moses holding the staff at the front of the crowd on the left and raising the rod on the right is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, tanned skin and a brown mantle over a pale robe.

Watson in the armchair on the left and seated in the dark room on the right are both heavy-set middle-aged men with short brown hair, a full brown moustache and a lined ruddy face; the right is dimmer and slightly greyer but no clear cue conflicts.
Jesus calling at the tomb on the left and standing on the water on the right has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, full dark beard, olive skin and a blue mantle over a pale robe.

Alice carrying the flamingo on the left and holding the bottle on the right is the same girl of about nine with long light-brown hair, fair skin, a small oval face and slight build; hair is wavier on the left.

Moses faces the viewer on the left (white hair, white beard, brown mantle) but on the right he is seen from behind on the rock with his face turned away; only white hair and a beard edge show, so identity cannot be confirmed.
